body:
Confirmed: it's a regression. It works in 2.4.
This was broken after the commit:  https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/commit/fb3f5044b89375eafb5cfc34d1004669d2b237c4

I prefer OPTION-1 as the simplest way to init `partition_key_ops_` before using it in `AnalyzeIndexes`. Let's discuss internally...
(Thread:  https://yugabyte.slack.com/archives/C3SP5KNAC/p1665171932695309?thread_ts=1663789082.605449&cid=C3SP5KNAC )
